rationale: Braking behavior itself must be characterised to evaluate the goal of preventing unintended braking (SG-3). H-3 establishes both the operating situation and the hazardous sudden stop without an obstacle ahead. P stays within that braking phenomenon and does not incorporate supporting observation, computation, communication, failure-mitigation, or timing mechanisms.
determining_elements: “Braking behavior of the ego vehicle” directly identifies the behavior addressed by the evaluation target.
“Whether braking occurs when no obstacle is present” captures the relationship central to H-3 without declaring every such braking event unintended.
The declared road, speed, weather, and visibility conditions match H-3's operational situation.
“Any braking maneuver occurring in that situation” remains within the target's braking phenomenon rather than extending to mechanisms that produce or monitor it.
